scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 . && pnpm run check:readmes && pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm -r --if-present run lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test scripts/release/readme-rules.test.mjs && pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm --filter "./templates/*" run test
